alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 16 at 2:39PM EDT until October 17 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 2 to 4 feet. * WHERE...In Massachusetts coastal waters, Boston Harbor. In Rhode Island coastal waters, Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT Saturday. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
